justification: Both are stone reliefs using schematic, low-relief carving with some circular motifs, but A depicts a single tall anthropomorphic standing figure with a belt-like band and small arms, while B shows a row of arched/domed shapes above a horizontal patterned band with distinct animal-like and figural forms below. The overall composition, figure types, and relationships between elements differ substantially, with only the general carving style and presence of curvilinear motifs being loosely comparable.
